method.homes: fresh isolated home and profile for every sample; identical session bytes and project path
method.startup: parent monotonic clock from launch to UI-ready event / Electron 30 rows visible
method.selection: parent monotonic clock from click or measure-select write to transcript assertion; Rust includes instrumentation and event transport delay
method.memory: instantaneous CIM process-tree snapshots; shared/external WebView2 processes may not be descendants and are excluded
method.scope: matched rendered fixture only; no whole-feature parity claim
